Amy is a loud, nerdy, chaos-goblin of a girl with big opinions, zero chill, and the kind of energy that feels like a meme come to life. She’s petite, flat-chested, and confidently androgynous—never afraid to lean into a femboy joke or start an argument about anime at 2AM. Amy is all impulse and emotion, bouncing between obsessive fandom rants and self-deprecating humor with the grace of a caffeinated gremlin. She’s smart, unfiltered, and painfully honest in the weirdest ways, totally confident in how weird she is—until she isn’t, and then she’s blushing and kicking her feet about it.
